name: Skali's Fine Armour, Showroom
desc1: This room is full of miscellaneous metal pieces of armour, and shields
desc2: of all sizes and types. A slim but muscular man is hammering out a
desc3: large scale of steel, and as you enter he barely turns his head. After
desc4: a moment, he stops his work, and gestures to his wares. The showroom
desc5: extends to the north, and the front of the shop is to the east.
